intentProfile.routingReason: free_exploration: no Library, no restore target, open-ended kanban page creation with stateful interactions

styleContinuityAnchors.colorSystem: iOS-style neutral palette (#f5f5f7 bg, #ffffff cards, #1d1d1f text). Status dots: orange #e7ad51, purple #9ba5ff, green #4fc083. Primary accent #5e6ad2.
styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: Rounded rectangles: sm 8px, md 12px, lg 16px, xl 22px. Full pill for buttons and tags.
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: System sans-serif. 19px bold for greeting, 13-14px body. Apple-style UI typography.
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: Apple HIG: 8px base grid, 16px section padding, 12px card gaps.
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: iOS-like: pill buttons, sheet modals, segmented controls, table-row cards with status indicators.
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: Flat design with subtle shadows. Cards have 0_1px_3px shadow. Sheet has 0_-4px_24px shadow.
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: Emoji + Lucide icons. Column headers use emoji (📋🔄✅) per user spec.
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: Swift and responsive. Sheet slides up from bottom. Toast appears 1.5s. Cards move between columns.
